page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.12xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a baseline clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and application data. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers between cloud resources. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. By minimizing excess RAM allocation, resource density is optimized for raw processing tasks. This hardware profile is suited for compute-intensive workloads such as batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and CPU-bound compilation tasks.
